RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 0

Both you and the successful candidate are men, meaning your sex was not a disadvantage relative to the person selected. While an all-male panel may point to broader institutional diversity issues, alleging sex discrimination between two male candidates is legally and logically unfounded and will undermine your credibility.

Instead, focus entirely on qualifications and procedural transparency. You possess formal leadership qualifications—a master's degree in educational leadership and five years as deputy principal—whereas the appointee has less administrative experience. Send a polite, firm follow-up regarding your requested written explanation, asking specifically for feedback based on the objective selection criteria, scoring rubrics, and competencies evaluated during the interviews.
